responsibility: Provides a public assembler helper header for hand-written PowerPC assembly sources. It defines register-name macros, token-gluing utilities, function entry/exit macros for the major PowerPC ABIs and object models (ELFv2, ELFv1 function descriptors, AIX descriptors, PIC/PLT handling), optional CFI directives, and GNU-stack notes, giving assembly code a portable way to spell PowerPC functions across the rs6000 target variants.
